title: Crowned Magic Lantern
description: A ornate lantern with a golden crown floats in darkness, its body glowing with vibrant blue and teal magical energy depicting bats and lightning. The pointed metal base emits a purple light onto the ground below, casting a distinct shadow, while sparkling particles float above the crown.
prompt: A highly detailed ornate floating lantern with a golden crown on top, the body made of reddish metal with intricate frames showing glowing blue and teal magical energy with silhouettes of bats and lightning bolts inside, pointed metal base emitting purple light and casting a shadow on the ground, magical sparkles floating above, dark moody background with subtle red tones, dramatic lighting, fantasy style
